description: Use when the person gives a Keywordise job id (ten characters) or a keywordise.com/jobs link, for example 'tell me about job abcde23456'. Returns what the public page of that job shows: title, employer, place, date and a plain summary of the role. A job that has closed answers that it has closed. Apply with apply_to_public_job.

public_id.description: The Keywordise job id: ten letters and digits, the last part of a keywordise.com/jobs address (for example abcde23456).

name: get_public_job
title: Read a job by its Keywordise id
